description:
A command line interface for the Nitrokey FIDO2, Nitrokey Start, Nitrokey 3 and NetHSM.


This is a maintenance release that updates the bundled root certificates to remove the compromised emSign certificate, see https://github.com/certifi/python-certifi/security/advisories/GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2.

## What's Changed
• Add test for nethsm commands by @AdityaMitra5102 in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/805
• NetHSM CLI improvements by @mmerklinger in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/809
• Update OpenPGP key for Markus by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/811
• Update dependencies and release v0.14.1 by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/812

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/compare/v0.14.0...v0.14.1
